text:
Kuch baatein honthon tak aakar hi ruk gayi,
Tumne pucha nahi, maine kuch kaha nahi।
Faasle darmiyan sirf lafzon ke the,
Par yeh khamoshi bhi toh bewajah nahi।
Tumhe pane ki zidd nahi thi kabhi,
Bas tumhe door se chahna hi meri dua ban gayi।
title: Unkahee
description: A soft and heartfelt reflection on silent love and unexpressed emotions, curated for the PoetryKitaab community.
